2610.06146.title: Impact of Data Augmentation on Confidence Calibration in Melanoma Classification
2610.06146.paper_summary: Accurately quantifying the predictive uncertainty or improving model calibration plays an important role in medical image classification, in particular in melanoma diagnosis, where accurate uncertainty quantification can have significant implications for patient care. One of the methods for calibration improvement is data augmentation. In addition, data augmentation as a method for synthetically increasing the size of the dataset has been proven to improve the performance of models trained on imbalanced datasets. However, the impact of data augmentation, as a transformation of a part of the original data, on calibration of models trained on imbalanced datasets, in particular in melanoma classification is under-explored. We train neural networks on SIIM-ISIC 2020 melanoma classification dataset under two conditions: with and without data augmentation, and compare the differences in AUC and expected calibration error (ECE) in both scenarios. Our results shows improvements in uncertainty calibration using different augmentation methods.
2610.06146.paper_summary_zh: 準確量化預測不確定性或改善模型校準在醫學影像分類中扮演著重要角色，特別是在黑色素瘤診斷中，準確的不確定性量化對患者護理可能有重大影響。改善校準的方法之一是數據增強。此外，作為一種合成增加數據集大小的方法，數據增強已被證明能改善在不平衡數據集上訓練的模型的性能。然而，數據增強作為原始數據的一部分轉換對於在不平衡數據集上訓練的模型的校準，特別是在黑色素瘤分類中，影響仍然未被充分探索。我們在SIIM-ISIC 2020黑色素瘤分類數據集上訓練神經網絡，在有和沒有數據增強的兩種條件下，並比較兩種情境下的AUC和預期校準誤差（ECE）之間的差異。我們的結果顯示使用不同增強方法在不確定性校準上有所改善。
